title: Tmux and Claude Code: Sessions, Send-Keys, and the Ceiling
summary: A technical guide explaining how to integrate Tmux terminal multiplexer with Claude Code AI agent, covering session management, send-keys commands, and practical workflows for AI-assisted development using terminal sessions.
problem_solved: How to effectively combine Tmux's session management capabilities with Claude Code for automated and persistent AI-assisted development workflows.
why_valuable: Enables developers to leverage AI agents more effectively by providing session persistence, multi-pane control, and programmatic command execution through Tmux integration.
